 Tyler Herro leads offense in Friday's loss to Bulls 
 by Chris Schommer | Bucks Correspondent | Sat, Oct 24th 2026, 9:46am EDT 
 Tyler Herro led the Bucks offense Friday, dropping 34 points (12-24 FG, 5-10 3PT, 5-7 FT) while also dishing out four assists, recording one steal, and grabbing five rebounds in a 132-125 loss to the Bulls. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Herro continues an impactful start to the season on the offensive end of the floor, dishing out four or more assists and scoring 24 or more points in each of the first two contests. The guard will look to take advantage of his No. 1 role as part of a revamped Milwaukee starting five, averaging 29.0 points and 6.5 assists per game while carrying a usage rate of 33.1% so far this season.
